Members' registrable interests

Under the resolution of the House, within 28 days of making and subscribing an oath or affirmation as a Member, each Member is required to provide to the Registrar of Members' Interests a statement of the Member’s registrable interests. The registrable interests of which the Member is aware of the Member’s spouse and any children wholly or mainly dependent on the Member for support must also be included in the statement. The statement is to include:

  • in the case of new Members, interests held at the date of the Member’s election;
  • in the case of re-elected Members of the immediately preceding Parliament, interests held at the date of dissolution of that Parliament; and
  • changes in interests between these dates and the date of the statement.

The register of Members' interests is published below.

¹This entry is closed.
On 11 November 2017 Mr John Alexander, OAM, resigned from the House of Representatives and was again elected as the Member for Bennelong at a by-election held on 16 December 2017.

²This entry is closed.
On 27 October 2017 the High Court of Australia determined that by reason of s 44(i) of the Constitution Mr Joyce was disqualified as the Member for New England and had never been validly elected, and that there should be a by-election. A by-election for the electoral division of New England was conducted on 2 December 2017. Mr Joyce was again elected as the Member for New England.

³These entries are closed.

On 10 May 2018 Ms Justine Keay, Ms Susan Lamb and Mr Josh Wilson resigned from the House of Representatives. As a result, by-elections in the electoral divisions of Braddon, Longman and Fremantle were held on 28 July 2018. At the by-elections, Ms Keay was again elected as the Member for Braddon, Ms Lamb was again elected as the Member for Longman and Mr Wilson was again elected as the Member for Fremantle.

4This entry is closed.

On 11 May 2018 Ms Rebekha Sharkie resigned from the House of Representatives. As a result, a by-election was held in the electoral division of Mayo was held on 28 July 2018, and Mr Sharkie was again elected as the Member for Mayo.

About the Register of Members' Interests

The purpose of the Register of Members' Interests is to place on the public record Members' interests which may conflict, or may be seen to conflict, with their public duty. Matters which Members are required to register are set out in a resolution of the House of Representatives.
